rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something luxurious, especially a hotel, room, or vehicle.

example.english: This hotel's lobby is really luxurious.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店嘅大堂真係好豪華。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 daai6 tong4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou4 waa4

rows.note: Use this when luxurious mainly means high-end or superior in quality rather than especially comfortable.

example.english: This shop specializes in luxurious leather goods.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭專賣高級皮具。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zyun1 maai6 gou1 kap1 pei4 geoi6

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on luxurious comfort rather than expense or status.

example.english: It feels luxurious to watch movies on this sofa.
example.traditional: 坐喺呢張梳化度睇戲真係好舒適。
example.jyutping: co5 hai2 ne1 zoeng1 so1 faa3 dou6 tai2 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 syu1 sik1
